## PostgresGrammar class

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

Compiles blueprints to PostgreSQL DDL.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class PostgresGrammar extends Grammar 
```
**Extends:** [Grammar](./database.grammar.md)

## Remarks

Notable choices: `bigserial` for auto-increment keys, `jsonb` over `json`<!-- -->, `timestamp(3) without time zone`<!-- -->, real `true` / `false` boolean literals, and a single `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE` so foreign key order never matters.

`unsigned` is ignored — Postgres has no unsigned integer types.
